method: Normal approximation for a paired accuracy difference; scenario parameters not estimated from old or new test. Not a guarantee; joint two-estimand claim is less powered. Budget-gain variance includes unknown covariance and is not estimated here.
interpretation: At discordance 0.10, about 2.44 percentage points, not sub-1pp effects, are plausibly detectable with 80% marginal power. An inconclusive result does not justify equivalence.
